name: instagram-content-pipeline
description: Automated Instagram Carousel content pipeline for a personal EdTech brand

scripts.test-layout: node -e "const puppeteer=require('puppeteer'),path=require('path');(async()=>{const b=await puppeteer.launch({headless:true});const p=await b.newPage();await p.setViewport({width:1080,height:1080,deviceScaleFactor:2});await p.goto('file://'+path.resolve('layout-test.html'),{waitUntil:'networkidle0'});await p.screenshot({path:'layout-test.png',fullPage:false});await b.close();console.log('Done → layout-test.png');})();"
